text:
**Step 1 - Scene:** Breakfast. A toasted English muffin half spread with cream cheese, beside a portion of scrambled eggs.

**Step 2 - Vessel:** A white square dinner plate, about 26 cm. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**Step 3 - Items:**
- Toasted English muffin half
- Cream cheese spread on the muffin
- Scrambled eggs (pale, soft curds with black pepper)

**Step 4 - Area:**
- Muffin half: ~16% (~85 cm²)
- Cream cheese: ~11% (~58 cm²)
- Scrambled eggs: ~14% (~74 cm²)
- Total covered: ~41% of the plate

**Step 5 - Volume:**
- Muffin: 85 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 128 ml
- Cream cheese: 58 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 29 ml
- Eggs: 74 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 111 ml

**Step 6 - Grams:** The muffin is airy, so I used a lower density (~0.3 g/ml) than the bread-slice range, giving ~38 g. Cream cheese at 1.0 g/ml gives ~25 g after trimming the thin spread. Eggs at 0.9 g/ml give ~100 g.

**Step 7 - Energy:**
- Muffin: 38 g × 240 kcal/100 g ≈ 91 kcal
- Cream cheese: 25 g × 340 kcal/100 g ≈ 85 kcal
- Scrambled eggs: 100 g × 155 kcal/100 g ≈ 155 kcal

**Step 8 - Sanity check:** About 165 g and about 330 kcal fits a half muffin with spread plus a modest egg portion. The plate is only partly covered, so the total stays well below a full dinner plate.

**Total:** ~165 g, ~330 kcal
